name: Tachibana Rikurou
source: Rikuro is a high school boy who, while on a school trip, gets kidnapped by slave traders but shortly rescued by Annerose. However, he is forced to bind himself to her through a contract. He is made into a living "zombie". He cannot die as long as Annerose still lives. He serves as both her servant and bodyguard.
